messages:
sophie_pd: uploaded a quick mock for a "dense rows" mode in vectors preview — goal is to show 6 vectors per row and collapse metadata by default. figma: https://figma.redwood/example/dense-rows (mock)

maria_design: looks great for scannability. question: how obvious is the collapse affordance? can we add a visible chevron + sr-only text like `Toggle details` so screen reader users get context?

jamal_frontend: hover actions (copy / export) look tidy but hover-only is a problem on touch. suggest a persistent kebab menu that appears on hover and is keyboard-focusable. use `aria-haspopup="menu"` and ensure 44px hit area.

kevin_proddev: export semantics: if a user selects multiple rows, export modal should default to "Export selected (N)" not "Export page". also we need clear copy for what fields are included. proposed modal header: "Export selected 12 vectors (CSV)" and secondary copy: "Includes id, embedding, source, and metadata. For large exports we will run this job in the background and email you a download link."

maria_design: a11y nit — the relevance badge color doesn't hit contrast, especially the light green used for high relevance. propose darker fill + white bold text, and a focus ring for keyboard nav. also add `aria-pressed` when pinning rows.

aria_bot: a11y-scan: flagged components — `.relevance-badge` contrast ratio 2.8:1 (fail), collapse control missing `aria-expanded` attribute, hover-only controls flagged for no keyboard target.

jamal_frontend: implementation notes: prefer a small inline menu button (kebab) that also renders as a visible mini-icon on focus. code sketch: `<button class="row-menu" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">⋯</button>` — on open set `aria-expanded="true"`. for animations, avoid animating layout height for many virtualized rows.

sophie_pd: good catch. for the collapse affordance I was thinking a small chevron + "Show details" tooltip. do we need persistent affordance even when collapsed so people know the row can expand?

jamal_frontend: yes keep the affordance visible. collapsed state should have `aria-expanded="false"` and keyboard users should be able to toggle with Enter/Space. for perf: use virtualization + a single expanding panel component so DOM updates are minimal.

kevin_proddev: export UX follow-up: for selections > 1000 we should definitely background the job and surface an in-app notification + email. copy for that state: "Your export is processing — we'll email a link when it's ready." add a small CTA to view export history.

maria_design: another micro copy tweak: change the button label from "Export vectors" to "Download vectors" when download starts, and show a tiny spinner + aria-live region: `status: Export started` so screen readers are informed.

aria_bot: accessibility tests queued for staging after changes. failing rules to re-check: color-contrast, keyboard-focusable, aria-attributes.

kevin_proddev: one more product ask — can the export modal show estimated size (rows x columns) and an estimated wait time for large jobs? if so, show an opt-out checkbox: "Run in background and notify me".

jamal_frontend: estimate calc is easy if we know selected count and fields. we'll add the opt-out checkbox. for animations: prefer CSS `max-height` transitions and prefer `transform` on inner content to reduce reflow. still recommend virtualized list when >= 200 rows.

sophie_pd: thanks all. i'll update the figma with: 1) visible chevron + sr-copy 2) kebab menu on hover/focus with keyboard support 3) darker relevance badge + focus ring 4) revised export modal copy + background job copy + opt-out checkbox. new mock link: https://figma.redwood/example/dense-rows-v2 please react with :eyes: if you want to test keyboard nav in sprint 42.
